items.title: Manuel Paul Interview, 1960-04-19
items.q: Is he the name of Celestan Porter? Is that his name? No, not Porter.

ctx.x: I think I know who you mean. Yes, well, it'll come to me later on. Now here's Israel Garman, Andrew Morgan.
Is he the name of Celestan Porter? Is that his name? No, not Porter. Oh, well, I don't know. No, that's not Porter.
Uh, here's Andrew Morgan. Oh, yeah.
